description: Conservative storage policies; no automatic cleanup, disk indexing shutdown or scheduled scans.

policies.name: Do Not Index Encrypted Files
policies.description: Prevents Windows Search from indexing encrypted files, reducing exposure of sensitive content. Does not disable general indexing.

policies.name: Disable Thumbnail Cache on Network Folders
policies.description: Prevents creation of hidden thumbs.db thumbnail cache files on network folders; can slightly slow thumbnail display.
